_comment: M10 PR 2's first commit (SPEC/10 section 2 'A raw record carries no credential'; tool-owner note 6 on PR 1; R5): an access-log line that carries a bearer token, which no access-log format of the construct's writes but which a log line could. src/verdict/caller.from_raw must refuse it, naming the field, so no credential reaches an envelope under evals/history/. The token is a placeholder: its header and payload decode to {"alg":"RS256","kid":"placeholder"} and {"sub":"placeholder"}, and its signature is the word 'signature'. A fixture, never evidence.
